Check out the red badge in set 05, this is probably the clearest example that you've posted: https://img.hdbits.org/g01/EwxdL6G/wVgcrv3

The built in Spline36Resize has incorrect chroma placement (assumes mpeg-1 placement rather than mpeg-2 (or center rather than center-left)), Spline36ResizeMod fixes this but z_Spline36Resize goes a step further and uses higher precision during processing for a more accurate result, it is beneficial to use z_resizers in all situations.

Thanks for the comparisons regardless
